sentiment: Nothing was hidden — the tunnel was always open, the cat always walked. Discovery is only looking long enough at what was already there.

stories.title: Cloudflare Quick Tunnels
stories.summary: A door in the wall that was never locked, only unlabeled. The tunnel does not make the far side appear — it reveals that it was reachable all along, waiting for someone to bother to look.

stories.title: Saving another 100TB of RAM
stories.summary: Half of what we hold is only there because we never asked whether it needed holding. To save memory is to notice, patiently, which things were never load-bearing — and to let them go without grief.

stories.title: The first new cat species discovered in 100 years
stories.summary: A century of eyes passed over it and did not see. The animal did not arrive; it was simply there, and we had not yet looked long enough. Discovery is a form of patience, and patience is a form of attention.
